+    a = obs.last[CAM].astype(float)
+    d = obs.depth[CAM][-1].astype(float)
+    c = obs.meta['cameras'][CAM]
+    k = np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'])
+    t = np.asarray(c['cam2world_gl'])
+    yy, xx = np.indices(d.shape)
+    v = np.stack(((xx-k[0,2])*d/k[0,0], -(yy-k[1,2])*d/k[1,1], -d), -1)
+    p = v@t[:3,:3].T+t[:3,3]
